evals.prompt: We are 3 founders building a B2B SaaS for accounting firms. We have 5 unpaid pilots, no revenue, and we keep changing priorities. Set up an operating system for the next 90 days.
evals.expected_output: A stage-appropriate 90-day operating plan with strategy, metrics, cadence, decision rights, customer learning, cash discipline, risks, and next-week actions.

evals.prompt: Our ecommerce brand is at $120k/month revenue but fulfillment errors and customer complaints are rising. We need a management rhythm and KPIs.
evals.expected_output: A focused operating rhythm and KPI scorecard emphasizing delivery quality, customer issues, cash/margins, accountability, and process improvement.

evals.prompt: I want to hire a sales team before product-market fit so we can grow faster. Help me design the company setup.
evals.expected_output: A skeptical response that challenges hiring before validated demand, identifies assumptions, proposes cheaper validation and sales-learning routines, and defines hiring gates.
